notes:
- Choose colors now has a Printer list when you have more than one U1: pick U1 2 (or any other) and the window loads that printer's filaments and suggests the colors again.
- The button and the hints say which U1 they mean (e.g. "Filaments on U1 2").
- When you open in the slicer, the file remembers that printer, so printing it later goes to the same U1.
- New heads-up when one model mixes materials that don't bond well, like PLA + PETG.
